steps.text: Show the organiser-only End trip control for an active trip.
Ask the organiser to confirm that the ledger is final.
Validate the authenticated organiser and active trip state.
Persist the trip status as completed and refresh the snapshot.
Load the completed trip snapshot for a current member.
Display its completed state, ledger totals, and member bill.
Withhold controls that add funds or expenses.
Receive a contribution or expense command for the trip.
Read the authoritative trip lifecycle state.
Reject the command when the trip is completed without creating ledger records.
